canonical_project: National AI Computing Center at Solaseado Data Center Park
owner: Samsung SDS-led consortium / KOACC; Ministry of Science and ICT; Naver Cloud
notes: Samsung SDS said the consortium selected and inspected the Haenam Solaseado site. Government and industry reports say MSIT held the groundbreaking on 2026-08-03 at Solaseado Data Center Park, with completion targeted in 2028. Local reports cite 40MW and roughly 15,000 AI semiconductors/GPUs.
